name: MiniStore
subtitle: SideStore with UI upgrades and preloaded sources

releases.localizedDescription:
#### This is release for:
  - version: "0.6.4-20260815.1+86e7f6f2"
  - revision: "86e7f6f2"
  - timestamp: "Sat Aug 15 01:15:41 2026"

#### What's Changed:
- Merge pull request #2 from The-Big-Mini/claude/ministore-uiux-fork-rebuild-35b74e
- feat(settings): adopt MiniStore's settings look and make OLED app-wide
- fix(tabs): keep the selected tab when the tab bar changes
- feat(settings): add OLED dark mode, tab hiding, and a default tab
- feat(naming): show MiniStore on the splash screen
- fix(sources): drop the dead MiniStore feeds and rename the inherited app record
- fix(ci): publish the release feed to this repo's gh-pages
- feat(icon): use MiniStore's app icon
- feat(sources): seed Mini's Repo, point self-update at the fork's own feed
- feat(naming): show the app as MiniStore without breaking iLoader detection
- Merge pull request #1 from The-Big-Mini/claude/ministore-uiux-fork-rebuild-35b74e
- fix(theme): apply the accent colour on launch and drop the storyboard global tint
- fix(theme): propagate accent colour to already-visible UIKit screens
- mark all lc related hooks with // @livecontainer line comment
- fix: make appgroup case mismatch fixer work for both free and paid accts with customization for paid accts
- try fixing appgroup case sensitivity mismatch issue during registration
- splash: removed the ugly spinner
- feat: make some fixed variables dynamic so SideStore can be bundled with other apps
- feat: limit max commit count in release message to 100 to not exceed GitHub limit
- fix compile issues and incorrect change
- fix: lockscreen widget wasn't using the resigned bundleid and was referencing static ids

#### Full Changelog: [10660919...86e7f6f2](https://github.com/The-Big-Mini/SideStore/compare/10660919f719664ae2d6f5f26b31c3ecda82e04d...86e7f6f2a37b8feac3489ac1d5881a00d151ad0e)
